source: Multiple Sources (Ancestry Guide, Rage of Elements, Bestiaries, Lost Omens)

ancestries.name: Aphorite
ancestries.description: Planar scions touched by the lawful energy of Axis, with metallic skin tones, geometric patterns, and an innate drive toward order and perfection.

ancestries.name: Caligni
ancestries.description: Pale-skinned descendants of dark folk who dwell in underground cities, with milky white eyes that see perfectly in absolute darkness.

ancestries.name: Centaur
ancestries.description: Powerful creatures with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a horse, galloping across plains and defending their herds.

ancestries.name: Dragonet
ancestries.description: Tiny dragon-kin with leathery wings, scaly hides, and a draconic lineage that gives them a breath weapon and an instinct to hoard treasure.

ancestries.name: Drow
ancestries.description: Dark-skinned, white-haired elves who dwell in the deep underworld, worshipping demons and slaving to expand their cruel empire.

ancestries.name: Ganzi
ancestries.description: Planar scions infused with the chaotic energy of the Maelstrom, sporting random physical mutations and an unpredictable nature.

ancestries.name: Ifrit
ancestries.description: Planar scions touched by the elemental fire of the Plane of Fire, with reddish skin, fiery hair, and an innate resistance to heat.

ancestries.name: Jotunborn
ancestries.description: Giant-kin with the blood of frost giants, fire giants, or stone giants flowing through their veins, towering over most humanoids.

ancestries.name: Merfolk
ancestries.description: Aquatic people with fish-like tails instead of legs, ruling underwater kingdoms and rarely venturing onto land.

ancestries.name: Minotaur
ancestries.description: Bull-headed giants with powerful horns, labyrinthine minds, and an instinctive drive to hunt, charge, and track their prey.

ancestries.name: Oread
ancestries.description: Planar scions touched by the elemental earth of the Plane of Earth, with crystalline growths, stone-like skin, and grounded personalities.

ancestries.name: Sarangay
ancestries.description: Water-buffalo people with golden horns and a powerful curse that compels them to seek out and hoard wealth and gems.

ancestries.name: Shoony
ancestries.description: Small, pig-faced people who value community, farming, and simple pleasures, with snouts perfect for rooting out truffles.

ancestries.name: Surki
ancestries.description: Insectile humanoids with chitinous exoskeletons, multiple arms, and a hive-mind culture that terrifies surface-dwellers.

ancestries.name: Sylph
ancestries.description: Planar scions touched by the elemental air of the Plane of Air, with pale blue skin, windswept hair, and an innate lightness.

ancestries.name: Tripkee
ancestries.description: Small, agile frog-people with adhesive toe-pads, long jumping tongues, and a deep connection to swamps and wetlands.

ancestries.name: Undine
ancestries.description: Planar scions touched by the elemental water of the Plane of Water, with blue-green skin, webbed digits, and the ability to breathe underwater.

ancestries.name: Wayang
ancestries.description: Shadowy, puppet-like people who dwell in the Plane of Shadow, with stringy limbs, exaggerated features, and a love for dramatic storytelling.

ancestries.name: Awakened Animal
ancestries.description: Animals granted human-like intelligence and speech through magic, walking on two legs or four depending on their original form.

ancestries.name: Athamaru
ancestries.description: Aquatic humanoids with fish-like scales, webbed hands, and gills, who build coral cities beneath the waves.
